title: Technical Sales Representative
description:
Technical Sales – Construction Products

Location: Remote – Anywhere in LATAM

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Employment Type: Employee

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

About the Role

We are seeking a technically knowledgeable professional to support customers with construction-related products, technical quotations, specifications, and project requirements.

This position combines technical analysis, estimating, customer communication, and sales support. The successful candidate will review project information, prepare accurate quotations, answer product-related questions, and help customers identify appropriate solutions.

This is a technical sales position rather than a general customer-service role. Training will be provided on the company’s products, quoting procedures, and sales processes.

Responsibilities

  • Review architectural drawings, measurements, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Prepare accurate technical quotations and pricing proposals.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or contradictory project information.
  • Communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements.
  • Explain product options, specifications, pricing, and project considerations clearly.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, and other internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of quotations, customer communications, and project updates.
  • Follow up on open quotations and support opportunities through the sales process.
  • Develop detailed knowledge of the company’s construction products and systems.
  • Provide professional support to customers primarily located in the United States.

Required Qualifications

  • Completed, or nearing completion of, a degree in a relevant technical field, such as:
  • Architecture
  • Civil engineering
  • Architectural engineering
  • Construction engineering
  • Industrial design
  • Product design involving physical products or building systems
  • A closely related engineering or construction discipline
  • Advanced professional English proficiency, approximately CEFR C1 or higher.
  • Ability to communicate naturally and confidently with customers in English.
  • Ability to explain technical information in a clear and organized manner.
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand drawings, dimensions, specifications, and product information.
  • Availability to work full-time during the established U.S. Eastern Time schedule.
  • Reliable computer, internet connection, webcam, and workspace suitable for professional calls and confidential business conversations.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

  • Construction or architectural-product estimating
  • Doors, windows, glass, glazing, cabinetry, millwork, or building materials
  • Reading construction drawings, plans, measurements, and specifications
  • Preparing technical quotations, estimates, or pricing proposals
  • Coordinating with customers, suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, or installation teams
  • Technical sales, project coordination, or customer-facing construction roles

Previous experience with doors is helpful but not required.

Virtual-Office Environment

This position operates in a live, video-enabled virtual office during scheduled working hours. Team members are expected to keep their video enabled and remain available for real-time communication and collaboration, except during approved breaks, private conversations, or when an accommodation or applicable law requires otherwise.

Applicants should carefully consider this working arrangement before applying.

Interview Process

Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in an English-language video interview covering:

  • Technical education and relevant experience
  • Experience with drawings, specifications, estimating, or quotations
  • Problem-solving and project coordination
  • Interest in developing a technical sales career
  • Schedule, equipment, and virtual-office availability
  • Compensation expectations and potential start date

Applicants will be informed before any interview is recorded, and recordings will only be collected with their consent.

Equal Opportunity

  • We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process and, where applicable, in the performance of the role.

title: Analista Senior de qualidade em pesquisa clínica temporária por 5 meses
description:
Senior Clinical Research Quality Analyst (5-month temporary role) - Location: São Paulo - Brazil

Hybrid (2x at Cidade Jardim´s office)

Type: 5-month temporary role

Who We Are

Intrials is a disruptive company with all the attributes that a CRO must master. We mix innovative projects with the necessary skills to provide a full service. Nothing stops us in the search for knowledge. Transforming people's lives through science when it comes to solving the challenges of our clients' projects in a focused and exclusive fashion.

Diversity & Inclusion are essential to continue building our history of innovation. Diversity of color, belief, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic are very welcome in all open positions at our company. It is a fundamental part of Intrials to constantly think and implement actions that reinforce the importance of good coexistence with all the people who are part of our DNA and together, to leverage and build true impactful results in our society.

Basic Functions and Responsibilities includes, but are not limited to:

▪ To coordinate the preparation, review, approval, and maintenance of all Intrials

Quality Management System (QMS) documentation, including SOPs, Policies, and

other controlled documents, as required.

▪ To review and support the implementation of quality processes to ensure that clinical

trials conducted by Intrials are performed in compliance with applicable regulations,

ICH-GCP guidelines, study protocols, and Intrials' or Sponsor's (SOPs).

▪ To prepare the Vendor Qualification process according to Intrials’s SOP and client

expectations (internal and external).

▪ To plan, coordinate, and participate in internal and external audits, sponsor audits,

and regulatory inspections, providing quality support before, during, and after the

audit or inspection process if applicable.

▪ To coordinate the onboarding quality process for new employees, ensuring

completion of mandatory Quality Management System and GxP training

requirements.

▪ To manage the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring its maintenance,

continuous improvement, and compliance with applicable regulations and company

procedures.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System, ensuring

its proper administration, maintenance, user support, and compliance with validated

state requirements.

▪ To support the validation and lifecycle management of computerized GxP systems,

ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal

procedures.

▪ To manage the deviation process, including deviation review, investigation

oversight, root cause analysis, CAPA definition, and effectiveness follow-up.

▪ To provide Quality Assurance guidance to internal departments regarding GxP

compliance, quality processes, and regulatory requirements.

Primary Activities includes, but are not limited to:

▪ To lead the vendor qualification and requalification program, including qualification

assessments, vendor audits, audit reporting, and ongoing performance monitoring

in accordance with Intrials' Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable

regulatory requirements.

▪ To plan, coordinate, perform, and report internal and external quality audits,

including site audits, Trial Master File (TMF) audits, process audits, and vendor

audits, ensuring compliance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, sponsor

requirements, and Intrials' SOPs.

▪ To support and participate in sponsor qualification audits, regulatory inspections,

and client audits, serving as the primary QA representative and coordinating audit

logistics, documentation, and responses.

▪ To coordinate the management of audit and inspection findings by leading root

cause investigations, reviewing and approving CAPA plans, monitoring

implementation, verifying effectiveness, and ensuring timely closure.

▪ To support the development, review, and negotiation of Quality Agreements with

sponsors, vendors, and other business partners to ensure alignment with regulatory

and contractual quality requirements.

▪ To manage and continuously improve the Intrials Quality Management System

(QMS), ensuring that quality processes remain effective, compliant, and aligned with

applicable regulations, ICH-GCP E6(R3), and industry best practices.

▪ To develop, review, maintain, and implement controlled quality documents,

including SOPs, Policies, Work Instructions, templates, and other QMS

documentation.

▪ To develop and deliver GCP and Quality Management training programs, ensuring

personnel maintain the competencies required for their assigned responsibilities.

▪ To promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying quality risks,

analyzing quality metrics and trends, recommending process improvements, and

supporting the implementation of risk-based quality management initiatives.

▪ To maintain current knowledge of applicable regulations, ICH-GCP guidelines, and

GCP requirements by participating in professional development activities, training

programs, and scientific meetings, applying acquired knowledge to strengthen the

organization's Quality Management System.

▪ To coordinate the Quality onboarding process for new employees, ensuring

assignment and completion of mandatory training within established timelines.

▪ To manage deviations, non-conformities and quality events, including review of

investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA implementation and effectiveness

verification.

▪ To review deviation investigations to ensure completeness, technical adequacy and

compliance with company procedures and regulatory expectations.

▪ To perform periodic monitoring and trending analysis of Quality Management

System metrics and quality indicators.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS),

including user administration, workflow configuration, change requests, issue

management and liaison with the software vendor.

▪ To support computerized system validation activities, including validation

documentation review, risk assessments, change control evaluation, periodic review

activities and maintenance of the validated state.

▪ To support periodic reviews of validated computerized systems to ensure continued

compliance with GxP requirements.

▪ To participate in Change Control activities related to quality processes and

computerized systems.

▪ To ensure Quality records are properly maintained, archived and readily available for

audits and inspections.

▪ To support the preparation, review and implementation of Quality Metrics and

Management Review reports.

▪ To identify opportunities for continuous improvement and lead Quality initiatives to

optimize processes and increase QMS effectiveness.

▪ To provide Quality support during implementation of new processes, procedures and

computerized systems.

Skills:

  • Degree in health science area (Pharmacy, Biology, Medicine, Nutrition, etc);
  • Knowledge of Clinical Trial Regulations;
  • Reliable professional training;
  • Good interpersonal relationships;
  • Good knowledge of GCP and ICH requirements guidelines;
  • Good knowledge of Quality Assurance processes, activities, tools;
  • Computer skills on Windows environment and Microsoft Office tools;
  • Experience in structuring quality SOP´s.
  • Advanced English; Mandatory to understand and speak
  • Preferably knowledge of oral and written Spanish (not mandatory)

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar, acompanhar e monitorar por meio de medições, coleta de dados e relatórios todo balanço hídrico da unidade, com leitura de hidrômetros e demais atividades inerentes, visando atender a gestão de demandas de água;

title: Tax Manager
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the company’s tax compliance for corporate, VAT, payroll, withholding, and local taxes.
  • Review and file tax returns on time, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local regulations
  • Support tax planning for wind farm development, construction, operation, and asset transfers.
  • Analyze tax impacts of project contracts, financing structures, PPAs, land leases, EPC agreements, and O&M contracts.
  • Coordinate tax audits, inquiries, and inspections from tax authorities.
  • Work with Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Project teams on the tax treatment of transactions.
  • Identify tax incentives, exemptions, and benefits applicable to renewable energy projects.
  • Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
  • Supervise external tax advisors and ensure deliverables are met.
  • Prepare tax reports for management and support accounting closing processes.
  • Act as the Tax key user for SAP implementation and enhancement projects,supporting tax requirements, system configuration, testing, data validation, and integration with Finance, Procurement, and other relevant modules.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of tax processes, controls, and automation within SAP.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Tax, Law, or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of local tax legislation and compliance processes.
  • Experience in tax management, preferably in energy, infrastructure, construction, or manufacturing.
  • Understanding of project-based businesses and long-term investment structures.
  • Ability to analyze tax implications of contracts and complex transactions.
  • Strong Excel and Financial Analysis Skills.
  • Experience working with external auditors and tax authorities.
  • Good communication skills to work across technical, legal, and finance teams.
  • High attention to detail, organization, and deadline management.
  • English proficiency is required.

title: Consultor de Negócios Mercado Pago

- Criar e manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes da carteira;

- Ajudar os lojistas a aumentarem o volume de vendas e recebimentos realizados pelas maquininhas Point;
- Identificar oportunidades comerciais dentro da carteira;
- Apresentar e estimular a utilização de outros produtos e soluções do Mercado Pago, como crédito, cartão, seguros, softwares e demais serviços disponíveis;
- Realizar visitas presenciais aos estabelecimentos comerciais;
- Acompanhar oportunidades, ações e indicadores da sua carteira;
- Trabalhar de forma constante para atingir as metas e objetivos definidos para a operação. --- O que buscamos - Perfil comercial e facilidade para negociação;
- Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento;
- Forte orientação para metas e resultados;
- Ambição e vontade de aumentar seus ganhos por meio da própria performance;
- Proatividade e autonomia para organizar a própria rotina;
- Comprometimento com clientes, visitas e resultados;
- Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes perfis de comerciantes e empresários;
- Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Zona Sul de São Paulo e região, realizando visitas em campo no mínimo 3 vezes por semana. Experiência anterior não é obrigatória. Estamos abertos a desenvolver profissionais que demonstrem perfil, potencial comercial, comunicação, energia e vontade de aprender e crescer. --- ⭐ Será um diferencial - Experiência anterior em vendas ou atendimento comercial;
- Experiência com adquirência, meios de pagamento ou maquininhas;
- Experiência em bancos, fintechs ou serviços financeiros;
- Experiência com gestão ou desenvolvimento de carteira de clientes;
- Possuir veículo próprio, carro ou moto. --- Modelo de atuação Região: São Paulo – Zona Sul e região
Modelo: Híbrido, com forte atuação em campo
Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) O trabalho acontece predominantemente de segunda a sexta-feira, normalmente dentro do período comercial, entre 8h e 18h. Como a função acompanha a realidade dos clientes da carteira, eventualmente podem existir atendimentos em outros horários ou aos sábados, principalmente no caso de estabelecimentos que operam em horários diferentes, como bares e restaurantes. Não trabalhamos com uma rotina rígida de controle de horário. O foco está em organização, presença junto aos clientes e entrega de resultados. --- Remuneração A remuneração é 100% variável e baseada em performance, considerando tanto a atuação do consultor quanto os resultados gerados na carteira. Quanto melhor a performance, maior o potencial de remuneração. Potencial de ganhos de até R$ 7.000 por mês. O modelo considera indicadores relacionados à atuação em campo, desenvolvimento e retenção da carteira, crescimento do volume transacionado, conversão de oportunidades comerciais e cumprimento das ações propostas. - Treinamento e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento na função;
- Modelo de remuneração que recompensa diretamente performance e resultados;
- Oportunidade de desenvolvimento comercial em um projeto ligado a uma das maiores plataformas financeiras e de pagamentos da América Latina. --- Quer fazer parte do time? title: Coordenador(a) de Eventos e Operações Web3 (Meio Período)
description:
A NearX organiza e acompanha eventos presenciais de diferentes ecossistemas blockchain , realizados mensalmente em várias regiões do Brasil por times de organizadores locais, além de eventos na própria sede em São Paulo.

Essas operações têm metas, prazos e documentação definidos em contrato. Por isso, precisamos de alguém que garanta que tudo aconteça do jeito certo e na hora certa.

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e focada em execução para ser a guardiã dessas operações : acompanhar indicadores, verificar se os eventos cumprem os critérios exigidos, garantir entregas nos prazos e colocar a mão na massa nos eventos presenciais da sede.

O que você vai fazer

  • Acompanhar os KPIs de cada operação: eventos realizados, participantes verificados, submissões e indicações mensais, conteúdos publicados e demais metas, mantendo painéis e registros sempre atualizados.
  • Garantir a qualidade dos eventos: acompanhar remotamente os organizadores locais para validar critérios exigidos (público mínimo, conteúdo obrigatório na agenda, divulgação prévia e check-in digital).
  • Cuidar do calendário e rituais: acompanhar a definição de datas com antecedência, publicação da página do evento, envio de lembretes e entrega da documentação pós-evento.
  • Cobrar e revisar documentações: conferir os pacotes de cada evento (resumo, lista de presença, fotos, avaliação pós-evento) e consolidar o relatório mensal de atividades dentro do prazo.
  • Controlar prazos contratuais: acompanhar submissões mensais, relatórios periódicos, logs de ações contínuas e validação de metas.
  • Produzir e executar eventos na sede (São Paulo): apoiar presencialmente na produção, logística, credenciamento, registro fotográfico e documentação quando houver encontros na sede.
  • Acompanhar ações contínuas: suporte a conteúdos, encontros online recorrentes, pipeline de builders /projetos e comunicação de relatórios.
  • Manter ferramentas atualizadas: gestão da plataforma de eventos, base de participantes/projetos e planilhas de acompanhamento.

O que buscamos

  • Atitude acima de tudo: proatividade para resolver problemas, vontade de fazer acontecer e disposição para aprender rápido (experiência prévia na área não é obrigatória).
  • Organização e disciplina: habilidade com gestão de prazos, uso de checklists e acompanhamento ( follow-up ) com múltiplas pessoas ao mesmo tempo.
  • Comunicação clara: firmeza e clareza para alinhar e cobrar entregas de times que não se reportam diretamente a você.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas: facilidade com plataformas de gestão de eventos e planilhas/dados (ou disposição para dominar rapidamente).
  • Presença em São Paulo: disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente no escritório da NearX (Vila Clementino, SP), com flexibilidade de agenda nos dias de evento na sede.

Diferenciais

  • Idiomas: inglês ou espanhol (parte dos relatórios e contatos com comunidades globais é em outro idioma).
  • Interesse por Web3: curiosidade ou vivência no ecossistema cripto/blockchain (não é obrigatório, nós ensinamos o que for preciso).
  • Experiência com eventos ou comunidades: vivência prévia com meetups , encontros de tecnologia ou comunidades de desenvolvedores.
  • Controle de entregas: histórico com rotinas que envolvam metas e reporte de atividades (aceleradoras, programas de fomento, DevRel).

O que oferecemos

  • Contrato PJ de meio período (4h/dia): remuneração de R$ 1.800/mês.
  • Flexibilidade de agenda: rotina diária de 4h, com maior concentração de carga nos dias de evento na sede (que não ocorrem todo mês) e compensação nos demais dias.
  • Imersão no mercado Web3: contato direto com comunidades, builders e projetos inovadores do Brasil e do mundo.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo: você será o ponto central da operação de eventos da NearX.

Ao se candidatar, conte resumidamente por que essa oportunidade faz sentido para você. Se já participou da organização de algum evento ou comunidade, conte essa experiência no seu perfil ou mensagem

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Account Manager / Client Success Manager (Upsell-Focused) Marketing Agency background

License & Scale — Remote | Full-time

Base: $4,000–$5,000/mo · OTE: $8,000–$10,000+/mo (uncapped upside)

We're hiring Account Managers / Client Success Managers who do more than keep clients happy — they grow them. You'll own a book of high-ticket clients, drive results and retention, and consistently identify and close upsells, renewals, and expansion opportunities inside your accounts.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $3,000–$5,000/mo (based on experience)
  • OTE: $8,000–$10,000+/mo with retention and upsell performance
  • Fully remote, long-term role with real growth path

title: Partner Account Manager
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 27 years.

We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world.

Today our team has more than 5 000 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.

Together we protect the world from cyber threats.

Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving!

The Partner Account Manager is primarily responsible for maintaining relationships and achieving revenue KPIs with a number of assigned channel partners. This includes developing sales strategies, negotiating with partners, and training and developing their sales teams. The Partner Account Manager represents the specifics of the company’s products and services to assigned partners, though they may focus on a specific solution or product set if a partner specializes in a particular area.

  • Manage the list of assigned partners to ensure booking target attainment;

  • Establish metrics to analyze and track partner performance;
  • Proactively assess, clarify, and validate partner needs on an ongoing basis;

  • Manage potential channel conflicts with other firm sales channels by fostering excellent communication internally and externally, and adhering to channel rules of engagement;
  • Lead solution development efforts that best address end-user needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company and partner personnel;
  • Ensure partner compliance with partner agreements;
  • Drive adoption of company programs among assigned partners;
  • Proactively recruit new qualifying partners or eliminate underperforming relationships as necessary.

Main Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred;

  • Strong channel management skills;

  • Proven track record of achieving channel sales goals;

  • Strong analytical capabilities (e.g., Excel, financial analysis of deal structures);
  • A results-oriented, process-driven, and hardworking professional;
  • Cross-cultural competence and experience working with international teams;
  • Fluent in English.

  • Cruzar o conteúdo com a legislação brasileira vigente e com outros sistemas de IA

  • Preparar planilhas de proposta, cadastrar propostas e participar dos processos licitatórios

  • Responder a quaisquer diligências
  • Completar todo o fluxo até a adjudicação e homologação do pregão

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência diária e profunda com Cursor
  • Experiência prática forte com Claude (API e Claude Code)
  • Experiência prática integrando e trabalhando com Grok / Grok Bots
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python
  • Experiência real construindo sistemas agentic (LangGraph, CrewAI, PydanticAI ou similares)
  • Capacidade de entregar código de qualidade de produção, não apenas protótipos

Diferenciais (nice to have):

  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry etc.)
  • Conhecimento de padrões avançados de multiagentes

Comece sua proposta com as palavras CURSOR GROK READY e descreva brevemente um projeto real em que você usou Cursor + Claude (ou Grok) juntos.

title: Senior SAP AP
description:
We are seeking a Senior SAP AP / VIM Engineer to lead and support our global Accounts Payable (AP), Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P/STP) digital landscape.

This role is responsible for ensuring that Accounts Payable processes, including vendor invoice intake, validation, approval, posting, payment execution, OpenText VIM workflows, bank payment integration, and government e-Invoicing compliance, are effectively designed, implemented, and optimized within an SAP S/4HANA environment.

The successful candidate will govern digital capabilities supporting AP, OpenText VIM, and integrations across procurement platforms, global banking networks, OCR/invoice capture solutions, tax and compliance systems, and government e-Invoicing platforms. You will work closely with Finance Operations, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Digital Integration, and Compliance teams to drive process accuracy, automation, controls, and global standardization.

This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative SAP AP expert to influence and shape a global Straight-Through Processing (STP) automation strategy while ensuring strong alignment with Record-to-Report (RTR) processes, financial controls, and close requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support SAP Accounts Payable and OpenText VIM solutions in a global environment.
  • Design, implement, and optimize AP processes, workflows, and integrations.
  • Manage vendor invoice processing, approvals, payment execution, and exception handling.
  • Support integration with banking platforms, OCR technologies, procurement solutions, and e-Invoicing systems.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve automation, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure alignment with financial controls, reconciliation processes, and month-end close requirements.
  • Drive global standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across AP operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with SAP FI-AP and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
  • Strong expertise in OpenText VIM, including workflow management, exception handling, document processing, and AP operational support.
  • Strong expertise in SAP AP configuration, including:
  • Invoice posting
  • Automatic payment program
  • Payment methods
  • Withholding tax
  • Tolerance limits
  • Vendor open-item management
  • Experience with bank and payment integrations, including ISO 20022 and SWIFT-based connectivity.
  • Experience supporting OCR or intelligent invoice capture solutions and AP automation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of STP and RTR processes, reconciliations, internal controls, and month-end close requirements.
  • Proven experience implementing global government e-Invoicing projects.
  • Availability during standard business hours. No on-call or weekend support required.
  • Must be located in Brazil and available to work Brazil business hours (or up to one hour earlier). Availability approximately three hours ahead of Eastern Time is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency (English-only environment).
  • Long-term engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP S/4HANA Finance and/or OpenText VIM certification.
  • Extensive experience leading global AP-focused e-Invoicing implementations and support activities.
  • Experience integrating SAP with procurement platforms such as Ariba, Coupa, or similar supplier invoicing ecosystems.

What You Can Expect from Us

  • Continuous professional development aligned with your career goals.
  • Opportunities for international experience.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and innovative work environment.
  • Exposure to global projects and cutting-edge technologies.
  • Strong focus on career growth, learning, and professional advancement.

title: Engenheiro de Produto Mecânico (construção industrializada) - Projeto de inovação
description:
Engenheiro de Produto Mecânico — Projeto de Inovação

*Sobre a vaga*

A Flexcubic foi contemplada com uma verba da FINEP para desenvolver um projeto de

inovação, cujo objetivo central é introduzir um material alternativo no

sistema construtivo industrializado atual. Essa vaga é uma peça-chave desse projeto: a pessoa

será responsável pela engenharia mecânica dos componentes que incorporam esse novo

material, respondendo tecnicamente por toda a homologação do produto, da definição dos

protocolos de teste até a validação final, o que exige domínio técnico real, não apenas

acompanhamento de processo.

Buscamos alguém que goste genuinamente de atuar em projetos de inovação, especialmente

em inovação aplicada à construção industrializada, e que já tenha familiaridade com esse

universo (sistemas modulares, off-site, industrialização de componentes).

*Principais Responsabilidades*

1. Desenvolvimento e Detalhamento de Projeto

- Projeto Mecânico 3D/2D: elaborar e revisar projetos mecânicos no SolidWorks e AutoCAD,

aplicando conceitos de tolerância dimensional e geométrica (GD&T e Análise de Stack-up).

- Análises de Engenharia (FEA/DFMA): analisar e/ou validar análises estruturais e

operacionais para otimização do produto e mitigação de falhas na produção e montagem.

- Sistemas de Fixação/Montagem: especificar e definir tecnicamente os elementos e métodos

de união (parafusos, soldas, colagens e encaixes).

2. Homologação do Material Reciclado (núcleo técnico do projeto de inovação)

- Interface Técnica com Parceiros e Fornecedores: atuar diretamente com parceiros

(ex.: Yatto) e fornecedores no desenvolvimento e aceite técnico de PVC e blendas

recicladas para uso estrutural/construtivo.

- Protocolos de Validação: criar e conduzir os protocolos de teste, definindo os

critérios técnicos de qualidade para homologação das novas matérias-primas

sustentáveis — do desenho do ensaio à interpretação dos resultados.

- Participação Integral nos Testes: acompanhar e participar de todos os testes e ensaios

de homologação do produto com material reciclado, sendo referência técnica do projeto

nessa frente perante parceiros, laboratórios e ICTs.

- Documentação Técnica para a FINEP: apoiar a geração de evidências técnicas e relatórios

de progresso relacionados à homologação do material, em conformidade com os requisitos

do projeto financiado.

3. Industrialização e Interface com Fornecedores

- Qualificação de Componentes: monitorar presencialmente a fabricação de componentes e

conjuntos mecânicos na base de fornecedores.

- Suporte a Dispositivos Fabris: prestar suporte ao desenvolvimento de equipamentos e

dispositivos de fábrica na interface entre Produto e Processo.

4. Validação, Documentação e Qualidade

- Gestão de Estrutura de Produto (BOM): estruturar e manter atualizada a Lista Técnica de

Materiais (BOM) e gerenciar alterações de engenharia.

- Documentação e Instruções de Montagem: elaborar a documentação técnica, manuais de

montagem e definir o sequenciamento produtivo do produto.

- Liderar a validação de produto junto a ICTs e laboratórios.

- Ensaios e Resolução de Problemas: conduzir ensaios de validação de produto, aplicando

DFMEA e metodologias estruturadas de solução de problemas (ex.: 8D, A3) para correção

de não-conformidades.

*Perfil desejado*

- Interesse genuíno e histórico de atuação em projetos de inovação — mais valorizado

ainda se em inovação na construção industrializada.

- Familiaridade real com o tema (sistemas modulares, off-site, novos materiais na

construção), não apenas curiosidade superficial.

- Maturidade técnica para participar de decisões de engenharia com autonomia, incluindo

a interlocução técnica direta com parceiros de material reciclado.

- Perfil hands-on: disposição para acompanhar presencialmente ensaios, fábrica e

fornecedores, não apenas atuação de escritório.

*Requisitos e Qualificações*

- Formação em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção ou área correlata, com vivência

industrial.

- Experiência em projeto de componentes mecânicos, detalhamento técnico 2D/3D e

acompanhamento do desenvolvimento de moldes e ferramentais.

- Domínio em CAD 3D/2D (SolidWorks e AutoCAD) e aplicação prática de tolerâncias

(GD&T / Stack-up).

- Conhecimento em diretrizes de DFM/A, DFMEA, validação de materiais poliméricos/

reciclados e análises estruturais (FEA) — conhecimento em materiais reciclados é

diferencial forte dado o núcleo técnico da vaga.

- Habilidade de articulação com fornecedores técnicos, parceiros de desenvolvimento e

equipes de fábrica.

title: Regional Finance Manager, Latin America
description:
Heidrick & Struggles is the world’s foremost advisor on executive leadership, driving superior client performance through premier human capital leadership advisory services. For more than 70 years, we’ve delivered value for our clients by leveraging unrivaled expertise to help organizations discover and enable outstanding leaders and teams. Learn more at

Job Description:

Who we Are

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory and on-demand talent solutions, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration, culture shaping and on-demand, independent talent solutions. Heidrick & Struggles pioneered the profession of executive search more than 70 years ago. Today, the firm provides integrated talent and human capital solutions to help our clients change the world, one leadership team at a time.®

Additional information on the firm can be found at .

The Role

The Regional Finance Manager - Latin America (RFD) oversees the financial activities for the Latin America region, encompassing five offices across three countries which generate revenue more than USD 20M. The position reports directly to the Global Finance Director for Executive Search (GFD) and partners closely with the Latin America Regional Leader (RL) and the region’s operational management team. This role plays an integral part in the company’s strategic direction, development, and future growth in the region and serves as the primary finance liaison to field operational teams.

Responsibilities :

  • Lead and develop the Latin America Finance teams, ensuring high performance, engagement, and robust succession planning.
  • Oversee Latin America financial assurance, the control environment, operational analysis, and recurring financial and business processes with an investment and value-creation orientation.
  • Develop an intimate understanding of the regional business, its key drivers, and market dynamics, maintaining strong working relationships at all levels of operations.
  • Drive annual planning and forecasting processes to deliver office and practice budgets, as well as strategic plans that enhance regional success, growth, and profitability, in collaboration with corporate and operational teams.
  • Manage monthly and quarterly detailed financial reviews and management reporting packages to measure historical and current performance, providing clear insight and recommendations.
  • Generate and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability across the region.
  • Create analyses and financial models to support regional growth initiatives, new investments, strategic and operational efforts, and to enable improved financial decision-making and sustainable performance improvement.
  • Use management information and KPIs to provide insight into trends that support the effective running of the region and drive continuous improvement.
  • Prepare presentations and supporting financial analysis and materials for leadership team meetings and regional reviews, as required.
  • Approve and manage regional expenditure budgets, ensuring disciplined cost management and alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Review and approve commercial Terms & Conditions for new business assignments, including margin expectations and risk considerations.
  • Own externally facing finance and operational components across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, including vendor relationships, leases, facilities obligations, landlord negotiations, benefits vendors, and other locally administered commercial matters, ensuring appropriate oversight, cost control, approval discipline, and escalation visibility.
  • Collaborate closely with regional finance leaders and accounting teams in other geographies to ensure alignment of financial strategies, policies, and operational goals.
  • Oversee locally administered payroll, consultant compensation, bonus accruals, statutory accounting, tax provisions, cash and intercompany activity, and related accounting entries, partnering with local tax, accounting, banking, legal, and labor compliance advisors to ensure alignment with US GAAP, statutory requirements, corporate policy, and local regulations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, with a strong record of academic achievement.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of corporate finance experience, demonstrating increasing levels of responsibility and scope.
  • Proven track record operating as a trusted finance business partner to senior leadership.
  • Intelligent and highly creative individual, at ease interacting with executive decision makers and discussing the pros and cons of project alternatives as a respectful, equal participant.
  • Strong sense of how businesses operate in a global context and the ability to bring a macro perspective to business opportunities and regional decisions.
  • Demonstrated project management expertise, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion.
  • Fluency in English and at least one major Latin American language (Portuguese and/or Spanish).
  • Recognizes trends and events outside the organization and focuses the organization’s financial, operational and human capital on the issues that affect performance.
  • Superior analytical skills balanced by a keen ability to integrate the larger strategic picture, rapidly understand and explain complex issues in simple terms, and develop a range of potential solutions.
  • Develops and applies creative solutions to business problems, anticipates situations and needs, finds flexible answers to new situations, and champions innovation to improve business performance.
  • Forms networks of positive business relationships that enhance personal and business success.
  • Partners with colleagues across all departments, service lines, and other regions as one team to ensure a successful outcome for the firm.
  • A well-balanced individual defined not only as smart, but pragmatic.
  • An outstanding communicator with excellent negotiation skills who will be viewed as a team player, with the ability to build a network of support from people at both corporate and business unit levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects with an ability to drive successful outcomes with a shared commitment among a diverse team.
  • Ability to work with the senior leadership of the Company as a peer, and to be perceived as a valuable business partner.
  • A self-starter who is one step ahead while ensuring that others on the team are not left behind.
  • Able to position and coach others to achieve industry-leading standards.
  • Strong work ethic and unquestionable integrity.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Chartered Accountant qualification; part-qualified accountants will be considered.
  • Strong understanding of Latin America taxation and regulatory frameworks.
  • Professional services sector experience; direct industry experience in executive search is not required.
  • Additional language skills beyond English and Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Heidrick & Struggles is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, veteran or military status, or citizenship status.

  • Operações em moeda estrangeira — controle de recebimentos e pagamentos em dólar e euro, com acompanhamento de câmbio
  • Relatórios gerenciais — margem por venda, por consultor e por fornecedor, com apoio à tomada de decisão dos sócios

O que buscamos

  • Experiência em agências de viagem, operadoras ou turismo em geral é imprescindível
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão de agências - STUR
  • Experiência consolidada em rotinas financeiras (contas a pagar/receber, conciliação, fechamento)
  • Domínio de Excel ou Google Sheets
  • Familiaridade com operações em múltiplas moedas
  • Perfil organizado e detalhista — nesse trabalho, uma comissão conferida errado passa despercebida por meses
  • Autonomia e boa comunicação escrita: o time é remoto e a rotina depende de gente que reporta bem sem precisar ser cobrada

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com empresa que tenha entidade no exterior
  • Inglês para comunicação com fornecedores internacionais

Formato

  • 100% remoto , de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo
  • Horário comercial, com flexibilidade
  • Regime de contratação: PJ
  • Remuneração: a definir

Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para  com o assunto "Gerente Financeiro". Conte em poucas linhas qual foi a rotina financeira mais bagunçada que você já organizou e o que você fez para arrumá-la.

title: ServiceNow ITOM Specialist
description:
For our international customer, we are looking for a hybrid ServiceNow ITOM Specialist.

Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain Discovery to ensure accurate, real-time visibility of IT assets and configuration items (CIs) across data centers and cloud environments (Azure);
  • Map dependencies between IT components and business services to understand service impacts;
  • Configure Event Management rules for alert correlation, noise reduction, and automated incident creation;
  • Integrate ServiceNow with monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Dynatrace) and develop custom scripts (JavaScript, REST/SOAP);
  • Manage MID Servers, troubleshoot discovery issues, and optimize performance;
  • Maintain CMDB accuracy, normalize data, and implement CSDM (Common Service Data Model) frameworks;
  • Responsible for controlling and managing the configuration items, configuration data and related changes to that data aligned to the objective of establishing and maintaining the configuration baseline, in conjunction with the various process, platform and product owners;
  • Lead process workshops when defining requirements and provide thought leadership and consensus building with stakeholders;
  • Capture business and user requirements, and provide estimates on the level of effort to deliver solution;
  • Identify capabilities on the platform to meet business requirements and provide estimates on the level of effort to deliver solution;
  • Follow standard development and coding best practices, including agile/scrum concepts;
  • Design and develop ServiceNow workflows and integrations according to project, process, and customer objectives;
  • Assess impact of changes and work with development teams to minimize technical debt on the platform;
  • Manage the pipeline of demand and ongoing development activities, and work with platform owner to reprioritize new demand;
  • Conduct review, system design, test, verification, and documentation activities;
  • Manage clone and promotion activities across environments, including update sets management;
  • Investigate capabilities on the platform and provide demos or build proof-of-concepts as needed;
  • Work with IT teams to build and support existing and new integrations with various systems;
  • Identify opportunities to improve and streamline the overall platform and its performance;
  • Create knowledge articles for internal knowledge sharing, and for consumption by other teams including the IT Help Desk and End Users;
  • Conduct roadmap planning based on platform capabilities against strategic business needs;
  • Lead annual upgrade activities and implementation, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure platform is stable;
  • Provide platform operations and maintenance support; Be available for off-hour release deployments and support;
  • Conduct patching and remediation of security vulnerabilities;

Profile:

  • Bachelor or Master degree;
  • +3 years of experience in IT operations;
  • +3 years of experience with ServiceNow development including Business Rules, Glide, scripting, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and ACLs
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, MID Server configuration, and API integrations;
  • Domain expertise and practical implementation experience in multiple applications on the ServiceNow platform (e.g. CMDB, Discovery, ITAM, ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HR Service Delivery, GRC, …);
  • Experience designing and developing Application Programming Interfaces (APls) with Representation State Transfer (REST), Simple Object; Access Protocol (SOAP), and JavaScript Object Notation (JSON);
  • Experience designing and developing solutions with PaaS solutions such as ServiceNow in an Agile Software Development environment;
  • Experience with Agile Scrum development methods;
  • Experience with Single Sign-on configuration and administration;
  • Experience configuring and maintaining MID Server;
  • Experience with Service Portal UI design and configuration;
  • Knowledge of SAML, Active Directory, or LDAP Integrations;
  • Experience leading workshops to solicit requirements, and explaining platform capabilities in layman’s terms;
  • Excellent documentation (writing and diagramming), interpersonal, and communication skills;
  • Great ability to work in a fast-moving environment and with minimal supervision;
  • Good understanding of organizational change management and communication;
  • ServiceNow System Administration or Application Development or Implementation Specialist Certification;
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Discovery, Event Management, or Service Mapping is highly preferred;
  • ITILv3 or ITIL4 Certification preferred;
  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure (networking, servers, cloud) and ITIL processes;
  • Fluent in English;

description:
Auxiliar de Laboratório de Prótese Odontológica — Aprenda uma profissão com futuro

Na Ciano, laboratório de prótese odontológica 100% digital, acreditamos que talento se forma com oportunidade. Por isso, não estamos procurando quem já sabe tudo: estamos procurando quem tem vontade de aprender, mãos firmes e cabeça aberta para a tecnologia.

Se você quer construir uma carreira com demanda, aprender uma profissão valorizada e fazer parte de um laboratório em expansão, essa vaga é para você. Você não precisa ter experiência — a gente ensina.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Você vai aprender na prática, acompanhando todo o fluxo do laboratório ao lado do nosso protético:

  • Fluxo de produção e acabamento das próteses em zircônia e PMMA — o toque final que transforma a peça técnica em um trabalho impecável
  • Preparo e organização dos casos, garantindo que cada etapa aconteça sem atraso
  • Apoio no fluxo digital: preparação de arquivos e operação assistida da fresadora (millbox) e demais equipamentos
  • Controle de qualidade: revisão visual das peças, zelo pelo detalhe e pela entrega
  • Organização e limpeza do laboratório, seguindo os protocolos

  • Habilidades manuais: facilidade com trabalhos delicados, precisão e paciência. Quem gosta de artesanato, desenho, pintura, modelagem, costura, manicure ou qualquer trabalho manual já sai na frente
  • Noção de computador: familiaridade básica com o uso de computador, porque o nosso fluxo é 100% digital
  • Vontade real de aprender: disposição para ser treinado, perguntar, errar e acertar de novo
  • Atenção aos detalhes: cuidado com a qualidade em cada peça que passa pelas suas mãos
  • Responsabilidade e comprometimento: o dentista confia em nós, e nós confiamos em você

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Habilidades manuais comprovadas ou aptidão clara (experiência com qualquer trabalho manual conta)

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no laboratório

  • Curso técnico ou formação em andamento

Como a gente trabalha

  • Mentalidade de "resolver junto": comunicação clara e transparente em todas as etapas — o dentista nunca fica no escuro
  • Ritmo dinâmico: fluxo 100% digital, do escaneamento à entrega
  • Cultura de aprendizado: quem erra, aprende; quem aprende, cresce

Por que vir para a Ciano?

  • Aprenda uma profissão com demanda crescente e boa valorização no mercado — sem precisar de faculdade para começar
  • Trabalhe com tecnologia de ponta: fluxo digital, fresadora e materiais premium (zircônia e PMMA)
  • Cresça com a gente: estamos em expansão e formamos nosso próprio time — a vaga de protético pode ser o seu próximo degrau
  • Mentoria direta: você aprende acompanhando um protético experiente, dia após dia

Se você quer uma oportunidade de começar do zero e construir uma carreira sólida, essa é a sua chance. Envie seu currículo e conte por que você quer aprender essa profissão.

title: Senior Data Analyst (SQL and Python) for a TECH start-up (USD 4-6K/month + bonus PJ)
description:
BASE SALARY - USD 48,000-72,000K/YEAR

BONUS - UP TO 30% of BASE SALARY

What You’ll Do

Core Goal: Deliver excellent customer solutions via reliable, high-quality data analyses, strong communication, and top-tier problem solving

You will be a hire at our early-stage, profitable startup. We are still figuring out many aspects of this business, and we’re looking for a hands-on thought partner to help build the company while managing a client relationship day-to-day. We want to be upfront: this is not a 9-5 job, and it’s

really difficult at times, but our shared mission to serve is what we rally around.

Client Relationships

You’ll be the primary point of contact for one client to start, which is a US-based company. This client treats us as an integrated part of their data team, and this project will require strong business acumen, SQL, and BI skills (ex. Looker/Tableau). Our typical workflow consists of scoping work, completing the work, performing QA, and presenting to the client. As you prove our ability to solve customer problems, you’ll look for opportunities to expand our footprint within each business.

Analyst Training + Management

At the beginning, you will be working on your own. However, our goal is for this role to grow into a people management role. Once you reach that stage, you’ll manage and coach a team of analysts who are true beginners. They typically won’t have college degrees and they’ll have no prior analytics experience whatsoever. Our analysts have previously worked as receptionists, delivery drivers, waiters, and in other non-technical roles. You’re not just going to be teaching them SQL/analysis/critical thinking, but also how to navigate a different culture in their second language (English) and gain confidence in their new skills. Most importantly, you’ll be transforming their lives by changing their mindsets about what’s possible through coaching them to independently solve hard problems. If done right, we believe you will be empowering a new learner to sustainably 10x their income in 2 years or less.

title: Supervisor de Contas a Receber
description:
About the Company

CMA CGM is one of the world’s leading transportation and logistics groups, operating across global markets and connecting businesses through integrated maritime, land, and air solutions. The Group is committed to innovation, operational excellence, sustainability, and the continuous development of its people and business.

Job Description

We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Supervisor to lead the company’s accounts receivable and collection activities, ensuring that revenues are accurately and timely collected while maintaining appropriate credit policies and terms.

This position plays a key role in improving cash flow, managing credit and collection processes, reducing financial and operational risks, and strengthening relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Our opportunities are inclusive and open to professionals with disabilities (PwD).

Mission

The professional will be responsible for overseeing the Accounts Receivable function, ensuring effective credit management, collection performance, and cash flow optimization. The role will lead the team, monitor key performance indicators, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and ensure compliance with internal policies and Group procedures.

Main Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Define targets, provide the necessary resources, and manage team performance;
  • Develop and support team members to maximize individual and collective performance;
  • Ensure the team has the appropriate skills and profile for the area;
  • Oversee communication, instructions, and performance of outsourced collection partners;
  • Monitor productivity, quality, and target achievement across the team.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Develop and implement strategic objectives to improve cash flow and manage DSO;
  • Manage credit terms and ensure compliance with established policies and procedures;
  • Assess and approve credit within established authorization limits, supporting the CFO in credit assessments when required;
  • Manage collection activities performed by internal teams and outsourced collection companies;
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate financial and operational risks;
  • Ensure accurate reconciliation of accounts receivable balances in partnership with the Accounting team;
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and performance information for key stakeholders;
  • Monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions whenever necessary;
  • Review and improve processes and procedures to enhance collection results and operational efficiency.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Commercial and Invoicing teams to accelerate collections and strengthen customer relationships;
  • Partner with Finance, Customer Service, Legal, and Operations to resolve accounts receivable issues;
  • Support internal and external customers by negotiating solutions to outstanding issues;
  • Provide effective solutions to meet business requirements and customer needs;
  • Maintain stakeholders informed through accurate and controlled reports and information;
  • Act as a transversal business partner across different functions to improve cash flow and customer relationships.

Management Scope

  • Leadership of a large team of 7 employees;
  • Management of internal and outsourced collection activities;
  • Coordination of projects and initiatives related to credit and collections;
  • Interaction with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities & Expected Results

The Accounts Receivable Supervisor will be expected to maintain strong performance against the organization’s KPIs, ensuring that accounts receivable remains under control and that collection targets are consistently achieved.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA is considered a plus;
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in credit authorization and accounts receivable/collection practices;
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Receivable leadership position;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Knowledge of SAP is considered a plus;
  • Fluent English;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.

Key Competencies

Leadership | Financial Acumen | Results Orientation | Planning | Assertiveness | Teamwork | Negotiation | Problem Solving | Transversality | Conflict Management

Join Our Team!

Be part of a global organization where your expertise will contribute to improving cash flow, strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence, and supporting sustainable business growth.

title: Gerente de Biogás
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Regenera Rio:

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, vindos de casas, comércios e indústrias, garantindo que tenham um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a criação de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia de reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação resulta na redução de impactos ambientais causados pela disposição incorreta dos resíduos, em melhorias diretas na saúde e qualidade de vida da população carioca e no avanço da economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a operação de biogás e biometano, desde o campo de gás até a entrega do produto para o parceiro terceirizado.
  • Gerir times de campo e escritório, incluindo operação 24 horas da planta.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Aterro, Chorume e Logística.
  • Garantir a performance operacional, segurança, continuidade e eficiência da planta.
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de crescimento do negócio de biogás, apoiando o aumento de receita.
  • • Atuar como peça-chave na estratégia de expansão do grupo no setor de resíduos, com potencial de participação em novos projetos e ativos do Regenera.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a evolução da operação, considerando a mudança tecnológica do setor (de geração de energia para purificação de biogás e produção de biometano).
  • Gestão do sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH₄), oxigênio (O₂) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.
  • Trabalhar na formação técnica da equipe, considerando que o mercado brasileiro possui escassez de especialistas em biogás e campo de gás.

Principais Desafios da Posição:

• Atuar em uma operação de altíssima complexidade e escala, referência no Brasil e América Latina.

• Gerenciar a maior produção de biogás do país, proveniente de resíduos domiciliares com alta carga orgânica.

• Conduzir uma operação crítica para o resultado financeiro do negócio, com forte impacto em receita.

• Estruturar e desenvolver um modelo de gestão mais eficiente, menos reativo e mais estratégico.

• Superar a escassez de especialistas em biogás no mercado brasileiro, exigindo formação e desenvolvimento interno.

• Apoiar a visão da Aegea de transformar resíduos em um novo pilar de negócio, replicável nacionalmente.

Requisitos e Formação:

  • Formação superior em: engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Produção, Química.
  • Experiência em operações industriais, ambientais, resíduos, energia, gás ou plantas de processo contínuo.
  • Vivência com operação de campo, plantas 24h e times técnicos.
  • Experiência em: Biogás, Biometano, Aterro sanitário, Tratamento de resíduos, Plantas de purificação de gases ou processos industriais similares;
  • Experiência com sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH₄), oxigênio (O₂) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente operacional pesado, com visão estratégica.

Informações adicionais:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

title: LATAM Channel Sales & Business Development Supervisor
description:
Role Overview:

As a LATAM Channel Sales & Business Development Supervisor, you will be responsible for driving business development and sales performance through distribution channels across Latin America and CLC Brazil Export operations. This role plays a key part in developing commercial strategies, strengthening distributor relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring alignment with regional business goals. The position also requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to maximize business results and market expansion.

  • Location: São Bernardo do Campo
  • The work model is hybrid: 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

On a typical day, you will:

  • Define and execute the commercial strategy for distributors, aligned with regional business objectives.
  • Act as the main point of contact between distributors and internal teams, ensuring continuous commercial support.
  • Support distributors across different business segments, including New Equipment, Modernization, and Projects.
  • Monitor distributor performance, including pipeline management, sales forecasting, and KPI tracking.
  • Identify growth opportunities, market expansion initiatives, and actions to increase market share.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Engineering, Pricing, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to support commercial opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with company commercial policies, distributor agreements, and corporate guidelines.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and channel partners across Latin America.
  • Lead and support direct and indirect teams to achieve business objectives

What You Need to Succeed:

  • Strong business development, sales, stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication.
  • Availability to travel within Latin America.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-driven mindset.
  • People management experience

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Marketing, Business Administration or related fields.
  • English and Spanish (mandatory).
  • Strong commercial experience working directly with customers and distribution channels.
  • Experience with CRM platforms and pipeline management.
  • Experience working with Latin American markets and multicultural environments.
  • Previous international exposure and business knowledge across Latin America
